subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], Thank you for choosing our airline for your upcoming trip. This email is to confirm your flight booking for the following itinerary: Flight Number: XYZ123 Departure: City A Arrival: City B Date: DD/MM/YYYY Time: HH:MM Please review the details and let us know if any changes are needed. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, Airline Customer Service Team
